standard.summary: 启动峰值保护持续多少个优化 step。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How many optimisation steps the startup peak protection lasts.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启动峰值保护持续多少个优化 step。0 表示整段训练都保留。一般前几步最容易爆显存，不用开太大

advanced_en.principle: How many optimizer steps the startup peak protection lasts. 0 = keep it for the whole training. The first few steps are the most OOM-prone, so no need for a large value.
